verdict.rationale: Provenance signals are a fair question for an AI image and video generator, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions C2PA metadata, content credentials, or a disclosed watermark on generated output. The docs cover resolution, audio, pricing and commercial-use plan terms, none of which are provenance signals.
